Job Title:

Entry-Level Java Developer (W-2) – Recent Graduates Welcome

Job Description:

Softech Technology Group Inc. is seeking motivated and career-driven recent graduates for Entry-Level Java Developer positions. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to launch their IT careers in a professional W-2 environment.

You will work alongside experienced development teams on real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience in enterprise applications and modern technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

Assist in the development and maintenance of Java-based applications

Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code

Participate in debugging, testing, and deployment processes

Collaborate with cross-functional teams on project deliverables

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

Basic knowledge of Java, SQL, and object-oriented programming concepts

Understanding of SDLC and software development methodologies

Strong analytical and communication skills

Employment Details:

Employment Type: W-2

Location: Multiple U.S. locations / Remote opportunities based on project needs

Start Date: Immediate and upcoming intake batches

We welcome candidates authorized to work in the United States, including recent graduates on OPT and STEM OPT.

Interested candidates are encouraged to send your resumes @ joshna@softechgroupus.com
